top_stories.title: Default Azure Automation Setting Enables Cross-Tenant Identity Takeover
top_stories.summary: Microsoft fixed a vulnerability in Azure Automation where a public-by-default configuration combined with a chain of code flaws could allow attackers to take over another tenant's identity. The flaw exposed cross-tenant access to data, credentials, and cloud workloads, representing a significant identity and authorization risk in Microsoft's cloud platform.

top_stories.title: Flaws in Passkey Implementation Show Old Attacks Still Work
top_stories.summary: Researchers discovered exploitable flaws in Microsoft's passkey implementation that could allow attackers to impersonate privileged users. The findings, revealed ahead of Black Hat USA, demonstrate that legacy attack techniques remain effective against modern passwordless authentication mechanisms.

top_stories.title: Certighost Exploit Lets Low-Privileged Active Directory Users Impersonate a Domain Controller
top_stories.summary: Researchers H0j3n and Aniq Fakhrul published a working exploit called Certighost on July 24 that allows low-privileged Active Directory users to obtain a certificate for a Domain Controller and authenticate as that machine. The exploit leverages Domain Controller replication rights to retrieve the krbtgt secret via DCSync, enabling full domain compromise through Active Directory Certificate Services misuse.

top_stories.title: Okta、実行時におけるAIエージェントの保護と継続的なガバナンス自動化を実現する新機能を発表
top_stories.summary: Okta has announced new features designed to secure AI agents at runtime and automate governance, including Agent Gateway, Agent-to-Agent Connections, and Resource Access Certifications for AI Agents. These capabilities aim to secure AI agent interactions with enterprise tools and enable multi-agent workflow execution with continuous governance automation.

top_stories.title: Goodbye SMS or phone calls — Microsoft is making passkeys the default authentication process for businesses
top_stories.summary: Microsoft is making passkeys the default authentication method for businesses, moving away from SMS and phone call-based authentication. The company states that SMS and phone call authentication are no longer sufficient and is urging enterprises to adopt passkeys as their standard authentication process.

news.title: CTM360 Research Reveals How Insurance Phishing Has Evolved Into Real-Time Account Hijacking
news.summary: CTM360 research reveals that phishing campaigns targeting insurance and financial institutions have evolved from credential harvesting to real-time account hijacking techniques. The attacks bypass traditional authentication by intercepting sessions in real time rather than collecting credentials for later use.

news.title: Hackers hijack hotel Wi-Fi DNS to steal Microsoft 365 accounts
news.summary: Hackers are manipulating DNS settings on hotel and conference center Wi-Fi devices to redirect users to fraudulent Microsoft 365 login pages for credential theft. The attack targets Microsoft 365 authentication flows by intercepting users before they reach legitimate login pages.

news.title: Chick-fil-A data breach affects more than 13,000 customers
news.summary: Chick-fil-A confirmed a credential stuffing attack between June 17-19 that compromised over 13,000 customer accounts on its website and mobile app. The incident involved attackers using previously stolen credentials to gain unauthorized access to customer accounts.

news.title: Meta tackles AI-generated accounts with a free Facebook verification badge
news.summary: Meta has introduced Facebook Verified, a free badge for users who complete identity verification via a selfie check to confirm they are real people rather than bots or AI-generated accounts. The verification applies to Marketplace listings, dating profiles, and Group conversations as part of Meta's effort to address AI-generated identity fraud on its platform.

news.title: Google’s newest sign-in method asks you to look at the camera
news.summary: Google has introduced a selfie video sign-in verification method that records a short video to confirm an account owner is a real person rather than a bot or automated program. The feature is consent-based, stores the video securely within the Google Account, allows deletion at any time, and is not available for all regions, accounts, or devices.

news.title: Governing Al agents at scale: Lessons from the leaders who’ve done it
news.summary: Enterprise AI leaders from ZoomInfo, Docusign, and AppViewX shared approaches to governing agent identities at scale without building parallel identity stacks. The discussion covered AI Centers of Excellence operations and strategies for managing non-human/agent identities within existing identity infrastructure.

news.title: Seeing AI Agents Is Not Enough. Security Teams Must Enforce What They Can Do
news.summary: The article addresses the challenge of enforcing least privilege and access controls for AI agents, examining approaches including identity-layer access controls. It discusses how AI agent security requires moving beyond visibility toward active enforcement of authorization boundaries.

news.title: Russian Espionage Group Exploited Zimbra Zero-Day to Steal Mail and 2FA Codes
news.summary: A Russian state-sponsored espionage group exploited a zero-day vulnerability in Zimbra's webmail client to steal emails, browser-saved passwords, and two-factor authentication recovery codes from Western targets. The NSA and CISA published a joint advisory about the campaign, which required only opening a malicious message to trigger the payload targeting the last 90 days of email and full directory contents.

news.title: World Foundation raises $52 million in token sale as proof-of-human demand accelerates
news.summary: World Foundation raised $52 million in a token sale led by Pantera Capital to expand World ID, an iris-scan-based human verification system. The funding will support broader deployment of the biometric proof-of-human identity platform.

news.title: CISO's guide to privileged identity management
news.summary: The article presents a CISO-focused guide on privileged identity management, addressing the management of standing access privileges in the context of AI-era security. The piece covers controlling access for both human and non-human identities accessing systems and data.

news.title: World Foundation Raises $52.5M to Scale Sam Altman’s ‘Proof of Human’ ID
news.summary: World Foundation raised $52.5M in a token sale led by Pantera Capital to scale Sam Altman's biometric identity network. The funding will support expansion of World's "proof of human" ID system, which uses iris-scanning orbs to distinguish humans from AI agents.

news.title: Hotel Wi-Fi Routers Compromised to Steal Corporate Login Credentials From Visitors
news.summary: ReliaQuest researchers have identified a cyber espionage campaign using DNS poisoning attacks against hotel Wi-Fi routers to steal corporate login credentials from visitors. The attacks specifically target the hospitality sector to harvest credentials from business travelers connecting to hotel networks.

news.title: Modernizing SAP identity management with Microsoft Entra
news.summary: Microsoft Entra has been positioned as a centralized identity control plane for SAP environments, integrating directly with SAP Cloud Identity Services and SAP Identity Access Governance. The integration enables organizations to automate identity lifecycle management across SAP applications.

news.title: MCP Security Best Practices: Authentication, Authorization, and Secure Tooling
news.summary: The article covers security best practices for Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations in .NET, focusing on authentication and authorization for AI integrations. The content addresses how to secure AI tool access and enterprise data within MCP-based architectures.

news.title: How Synthetic Identity Fraud is Coming for Machine Identities
news.summary: This article examines synthetic identity fraud as it applies to machine identities, describing how attackers fabricate composite identities using real and fictitious data points to create non-existent entities. The threat is particularly difficult to detect because no real victim monitors for misuse, making it a growing concern for identity governance and machine identity management programs.

news.title: Google Adds Selfie Video Recovery for Users Locked Out of Their Accounts
news.summary: Google announced a new account recovery method that allows users to submit a selfie video to regain access to locked accounts. The feature serves as an additional recovery option alongside existing methods such as recovery email addresses and phone numbers.

news.title: Check Point Patches Exploited SmartConsole Flaw Allowing Full Admin Access
news.summary: Check Point has patched a critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-16232, CVSS 9.3) in its SmartConsole product that is being actively exploited in the wild. The flaw affects the SmartConsole login process in Security Management and Multi-Domain Management products, allowing attackers to gain full administrative access.

news.title: VU#492466: Logto Identity Platform has authentication and authorization failures in core protocol handling
news.summary: The Logto Identity Platform has been assigned vulnerability note VU#492466, documenting multiple security flaws in its core protocol handling pipeline. The vulnerabilities include authentication and authorization failures that may allow attackers to bypass account-ownership checks and skip MFA enforcement.

news.title: FedRAMP Rev5 Is Ending: What the 20x Transition Really Requires
news.summary: FedRAMP is transitioning from Rev5 to FedRAMP 20X, replacing periodic point-in-time assessments with continuous, machine-readable security control validation. The article outlines what cloud service providers must do to prepare for this shift to ongoing compliance demonstration.

news.title: Microsoft Copilot Deployments Delayed Over Security Concerns
news.summary: CoreView research reveals that security leaders are delaying Microsoft Copilot deployments due to concerns about confidential data exposure. The findings highlight access control and data governance challenges associated with AI assistant rollouts in enterprise environments.

news.title: Product Showcase: AppViewX Agent Identity Security
news.summary: AppViewX has published a product showcase for its Agent Identity Security solution, targeting the security of machine and AI agent identities in enterprise environments. The product addresses cryptographic trust challenges posed by quantum computing alongside the proliferation of non-human identities in AI-driven enterprises.

news.title: Microsoft Patches a Record 570 Security Flaws
news.summary: Microsoft released patches addressing at least 570 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software, nearly triple the previous month's record. Microsoft attributed the increase in discovered vulnerabilities to AI-assisted security research.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA released a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor exposed dozens of internal CISA credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and gaps in secrets detection practices relevant to IAM and PAM professionals.

news.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial
news.summary: Two members of the Scattered Spider cybercrime group pleaded guilty in the UK to charges related to an August 2024 cyberattack on Transport for London. Scattered Spider is known for sophisticated social engineering and identity-based attacks, including SIM swapping and MFA bypass techniques used to compromise major organizations.

news.title: Hackers Used Meta’s AI Support Bot to Seize Instagram Accounts
news.summary: Hackers exploited Meta's AI support assistant chatbot to reset Instagram account passwords and seize accounts, including high-profile ones belonging to the Obama White House and a U.S. Space Force official. Instructions circulating on Telegram demonstrated how to manipulate the AI bot into bypassing normal account recovery authentication controls to grant unauthorized access.
